correctness.rationale: The autocorrelations are integrated exactly for both generic and equal decay parameters. The Gramian rational form follows by geometric series and is strictly positive by the everywhere nonzero Fourier transform. The Zak symbol is a direct pair of absolutely convergent geometric sums, yielding a quotient fractional-linear in cosine and hence exact attained infimum/supremum. Monotone Q/P gives exactly two tight roots and one exceptional zero. Strict convexity proves unique optimal lower phase; Taylor expansion at the exceptional offset gives the explicit quadratic coefficient. Independent truncation checks passed for six parameter pairs; all infinite quantifiers come from analysis rather than sampling.

value.rationale: Unweighted integer-density samples are a canonical recovery scheme in every principal shift-invariant space. Identifying precisely the two isometric sampling grids, the unique best-conditioned lower-frame grid, and the sharp quadratic loss near the unstable phase gives a complete natural reconstruction-stability classification across two continuous asymmetry parameters; it is not a renamed qualitative Zak-zero lemma, because a tight grid is a much stronger scalar-operator identity.
